keepOpen: Keep this page open until this transaction change is confirmed. If the request was interrupted, use Safe retry before leaving the workspace.
deletePermanent: The record will be permanently removed from the database and transaction history. This action cannot be undone; its audit history will be kept.
checkFields: Check the highlighted fields before saving.
pastDate: Choose today or a past date in the workspace timezone.
transactionDeleted: This transaction has been deleted. Close and refresh to load the current balances and history. It cannot be edited or recreated by retrying this submission.
deleteConflict: This transaction has changed since you opened it. Close and refresh, then review the latest record before deleting it. This attempt did not delete the newer version.
editConflict: This transaction has changed since you opened it. Close and refresh, then reopen the latest record to review your changes. This attempt did not overwrite the newer version.
deleteUnconfirmed: The deletion could not be confirmed. Use Safe retry to check or complete this exact deletion. The original record and version are preserved; retrying cannot delete a newer edit.
editUnconfirmed: The edit could not be confirmed. Use Safe retry to check or complete this exact edit. Its values and original version are preserved so a newer edit cannot be overwritten.
saveUnconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. Use Safe retry to check or complete this exact transaction. Its values and retry key are preserved; no new transaction will be created for the same submission.
writeDescription: Track added funds, daily expenses, and transaction history.
readDescription: View added funds, daily expenses, and transaction history. Only super admins can make changes.
deleteRefreshFailed: Your deletion was confirmed. The latest balances or history could not be loaded. Refresh the view to load the updated ledger.
saveRefreshFailed: Your transaction was saved. The latest balances or history could not be loaded. Refresh the view; do not submit the saved transaction again.
negativeBalanceDescription: Negative balance · all funds added minus all expenses, all time.
balanceDescription: All funds added minus all expenses, all time.
totalBalanceDescription: Cumulative funds added, all time. Expenses do not reduce this total.
pendingTransaction: A transaction change is awaiting confirmation. Safely retry it before starting another transaction.
historyDescription: Newest transaction date first. Only super admins can edit or delete saved transactions.
pdfDescription: PDF includes all matching records for the applied filters.
historyScroll: Transaction history, scroll for more columns
changeFilters: Try changing the filters or returning to the first page.
firstExpenseDescription: Add balance or record your first expense. The balance carries forward every day.
noTransactionsDescription: Transactions will appear here when a super admin records them.
deletionRecoveryDescription: This is the record you confirmed for permanent deletion. Review the result below before retrying the same operation.
safeDeleteHelp: Safe retry uses the same record and its original version. Keep this page open until the deletion is confirmed.
editDescription: Update this record. Its transaction type and original recorder stay the same. Balances update after the edit is confirmed.
amountHelp: Positive amount, up to two decimal places. No commas.
noActiveCategories: No active categories are available. Create or restore a category to record an expense.
categoryArchived: Category archived. Its transaction history is preserved.
categoryDescription: Archived categories remain in history and filters. Only active categories can be used for new expenses.
categoryRefreshFailed: Your category change was saved. Refresh the list to load the latest categories.
noCategoriesDescription: Create your first category above, then record an expense.
positiveDistance: Enter a distance greater than zero.
driveDescription: Calculate and keep a clear record of every drive.
reconcileDrive: Refresh drive costs successfully before trying another change.
calculatorDescription: Calculate total drive costs for a single day or a date range.
dateFilterHelp: Use the same date in both fields for a single day. Leave a field blank for an open-ended range.
distanceHelp: Enter the one-way distance. Round trips include the return journey.
roundTripHelp: For office → destination → office, choose round trip to double the distance and cost.
positiveBalanceAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero, up to 9,999,999,999.99, with at most two decimal places.
driveBalanceDescription: Total balance added minus all paid trips, across all dates. The balance can be negative.
balanceUnconfirmed: The addition could not be confirmed. Retry this balance addition to confirm the result safely.
refreshFailed: Could not refresh {subject}. Previously loaded data is shown. Use Refresh to try loading it again.
loadFailed: Could not load {subject}. Use Refresh to try loading it again.
deleteExpenseImpact: Deleting this expense will increase Current Balance by {amount}.
deleteBalanceImpact: Deleting this balance addition will reduce Current Balance and Total Balance Added by {amount}. Current Balance may become negative.
deletedSuccess: {type, select, EXPENSE {Expense} other {Balance addition}} deleted{replayed, select, yes { (the record was already deleted)} other {}}. Balances and history are being refreshed.
savedSuccess: {type, select, EXPENSE {Expense} other {Balance addition}} {operation, select, UPDATE {updated} other {saved}}{replayed, select, yes { (the earlier submission was already recorded)} other {}}. History filters are preserved; the entry may be outside the current view.
summaryScope: {currency} · {timezone} · History filters do not change these totals.
newTransactionDescription: {type, select, EXPENSE {Record an expense, even if it takes the balance below zero.} other {Record funds received into this ledger.}} Only super admins can edit or delete saved transactions.
safeSaveHelp: Safe retry uses the original amount, date, category, note, and {operation, select, edit {record version} other {submission key}}. Keep this page open until the save is confirmed.
drivePaymentSaved: Drive cost marked as {status, select, PAID {paid} other {unpaid}}.
deleteDriveConfirm: Permanently delete the drive cost from {from} to {to}? This cannot be undone.
noDriveCosts: No drive costs found for this {period, select, day {date} other {date range}}.
driveSummary: {count, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} · {kilometers} km
markPaymentLabel: Mark {status, select, PAID {unpaid} other {paid}} for drive cost from {from} to {to}
pagination: Page {page} · {count, plural, one {# total record} other {# total records}}
rateChangeHelp: Trips from {date} use ৳5.50/km in time and ৳11/km over time.
reportTypeCategory: Type: {type, select, EXPENSE {Expense} BALANCE_ADDED {Balance added} other {All types}} | Category: {category}
dailyReportFooter: All matching records across every history page are included. Deleted records are excluded. All-time balances ignore the selected filters; filtered net change is balance added minus expenses in this report. Positive amounts add funds and negative amounts record expenses.
driveReportFooter: All matching trips are included. Round-trip kilometers include the return journey (×2). Amounts use each trip's saved rate and are shown in Bangladeshi taka (BDT).
